newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) all lower.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) all lower.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover was thin at 933 million yuan though higher than last Thursday's 305 million yuan. The market has been closed since last Friday for the annual Lunar New Year holiday.
The seven-day contract was the most actively traded.
"Some short-term financial centres resumed business today, making trading a bit more active than early February," said one trader. "But state banks were still on the sidelines."
The centres are money brokerages run by the central bank.
Traders said the rates would move in a narrow range in the next two days. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
